source.arithmetic: exact rational inputs and dynamics; floats are display/learning estimates
source.safety_boundary: nonnegative clearance; contact at zero is permitted
source.timing_scope: Empirical matched geometric predicate and evidence construction; excludes offline reference, generation and action search; no simulated execution

timing.scope: Seeded layout, raw-sample medians, decision counts and paired distributions; mathematical decisions require separate replay, and clock authenticity is not verified

verification.scope: Full exact cohort/predicate replay and empirical paired-layout verification; no clock authentication or controller substitution

assumptions.model: Exact planar double integrator p_dot=v, v_dot=u; static circular forbidden interiors; radius includes robot size
assumptions.initial_set: The specified exact state; a successful one-hold certificate includes its initial geometric safety, not viability or a high-order filter domain
assumptions.actuation: The specified acceleration is held exactly and lies in the recorded componentwise actuator box
assumptions.observation: Exact state, obstacle center and total collision radius; no measurement or model uncertainty
assumptions.numerical: Exact rational arithmetic; radical-free tube test; separately implemented square-free/Sturm polynomial sign reference; no formal program proof
assumptions.execution: Exactly the specified positive hold duration; zero delay, no disturbance or contact dynamics; boundary contact is permitted
assumptions.cohort: Original HOCBF-domain cohort retained for matching; not a required initial-domain restriction of every geometric predicate

scope: Offline fixed-control geometric h>=0 comparison on an inherited cohort; psi preservation and diagnostic endpoint/chord checks remain separate. Includes evidence construction, excludes cohort/reference work; no controller, SSCBF reproduction, equal primitive-work, hard deadline or novelty claim
